scope: Three named CIF-LOCAL-DOMAIN-LIMIT anchor families, six immediate mirror modules and explicitly recorded supporting ranges; not a recursive repository audit or execution parity.

contracts.behavior: Group terminal surfaces by parent ID; retain same-environment pending bindings, prefer requested then existing then host-active surface; normalize duplicate PTY ownership. Keep client title/default/custom/generated/AI-Vault/quick-command/color/pin/view-mode metadata according to source precedence. Host omission clears launchAgent/startupCwd. Generated local tab ID and layout do not validate backend ownership or start a PTY.

Host tree covering exact leaf set wins, then covering prior tree, then empty/single/horizontal synthesized chain. Leaf coverage compares sets, not duplicate multiplicity or schema/cycle validity. Active selection prefers requested and existing leaf before host metadata. PTY normalization prunes duplicate bindings, prefers valid active owner, pairs buffer/scrollback provenance and remaps titles. No normalization occurs when there is no duplicate PTY. Preserve source fallback explicitly; comment/test title is stronger than checked assertion.

Reuse remote page only by workspace plus environment/page-handle identity. Exact local browser client ID preserves local URL/title/loading/navigation over stale host echo. Host fallback title retains local title only at unchanged URL. Client placement group must still exist/render; staged current group outranks recorded placement. Page object reuse requires field equality including workspace. loadError preservation uses any client placement, unlike exact-client content ownership; keep that distinction in fixtures.

Editor mirrored records overwrite host-owned file fields while retaining other existing fields; markdown preview identity derives from source path. Unified editor and browser color/pin prefer explicit host fields, unlike terminal client precedence. Agent rows use structured session ID, host/fallback group and Codex Chat fallback label. Structural guards are narrow and do not validate full payloads; partial mutations and mixed-version admission remain caller/backend obligations.

Remap host pane keys under launch/hook compatibility; retain client receipt time for equal authority observedAt, stamp new receipt otherwise. Client-owned fresh status is preferred unless blocked/interactive host state, but separate existing.updatedAt > entry.updatedAt fallback can still select existing state. Preserve host identity/message metadata except predating done-turn branch. Missing host status preserves client-owned rows without freshness gate; other mirrored rows can be removed. Update aggregate/sort epochs only for named relevant changes.

Validate terminal leaf UUID before key remap; ownership requires renderer registration plus a real client write, replacement dispose is identity-fenced. Remirrored IDs lift closed markers. Retraction sweeps only mirrored removed IDs, using post-removal tab list and preserved activity-cleared cutoffs; batch state/index is updated to avoid resurrecting swept rows. Sweep computation has registry side effects even if caller discards patch; it is not full closeTab cleanup or evidence of process exit.

qualifications: Strict body assertions, return values and exact owner checks govern; source comments are not proof of stronger guarantees.

agentStatusEntryEqual omits evidenceObservedAt, mirroredEvidenceReceivedAt and observation metadata. Source-inferred risk: a receipt-only change may be discarded when every compared field is equal. Existing clock-skew test changes updatedAt too and does not isolate this case; characterize independently before correction.

Blocked/interactive host status bypasses clientOwnsEntry but not the separate updatedAt comparison. Source-inferred cross-clock masking risk requires a fresh client with later wall-clock timestamp and host blocked-state fixture.
Typed recursive layout input is not bounded or cycle-validated here; set coverage does not reject repeated leaf IDs. Do not remove split capability to avoid malformed-input tests.
Pane retirement patch has registry effects and does not clear every closeTab map. Session retraction never authorizes host process cleanup.

Shared title profile detection, provider session comparators and store retirement internals retain their existing owning-domain contracts and complete original tests; the six specifically named source modules are reviewed, not every transitive import recertified.

assertions.name: layoutCoversLeaves is true when the tree has exactly the leaves
layoutCoversLeaves is false when a leaf is missing from the tree
layoutCoversLeaves is false when the tree has an extra leaf
layoutCoversLeaves is false for a null tree
resolveTerminalLayoutRoot uses the authoritative tree verbatim — direction is preserved
resolveTerminalLayoutRoot falls back to the prior client tree (keeping direction) when authoritative does not cover the leaves
resolveTerminalLayoutRoot never invents a split direction: synthesis only fires (and is reported) when no tree covers the leaves
resolveTerminalLayoutRoot does not report synthesis for a single leaf (direction is irrelevant)
resolveTerminalLayoutRoot returns null for no leaves
resolveTerminalLayoutRoot prefers authoritative over an also-covering existing tree
